_comment: Generic sample backends and 'query -> expected tool' pairs for search_tools (test/tool-search.test.mjs). Near-duplicates (search_*, list_*, move_*, delete_*) are deliberate. 'mustRankFirst' pairs a common word (list, get, delete, search) with a specific one; the specific word has to win.

files.description: Files and folders on the shared drive

tools.read_file: Read the contents of a file.
tools.write_file: Write content to a file, replacing what was there.
tools.list_directory: List the files and folders in a directory.
tools.search_files: Find files whose name matches a pattern.

tools.get_ticket: Get one ticket by its ID.
tools.search_tickets: Search tickets by text, status or assignee.
tools.close_ticket: Close a ticket with a resolution note.
tools.add_comment: Add a comment to a ticket.

tools.list_events: List calendar events in a date range.
tools.create_event: Create a calendar event (a meeting) and invite attendees.
tools.find_free_time: Find a time when everyone in a group is free.

tools.get_note: Get one note by its ID.

tools.list_vms: List all virtual machines with their status.
tools.stop_vm: Stop a virtual machine immediately (hard power off).
tools.shutdown_vm: Shut down a virtual machine gracefully.
tools.list_containers: List all containers with their status.
tools.get_node_status: CPU, memory and uptime of a cluster node.
tools.list_snapshots: List the snapshots of a virtual machine.

tools.list_emails: List the emails in a folder.
tools.search_emails: Search emails by sender, subject or text.
tools.move_email: Move an email to another folder.
